summary: @ornikar/slate-react-fork ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod+x's the binary, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (rotated string-array constant pool with a WV8StW rotator function and an hc1jfK9 base64-alphabet string decoder, hex-named variables) — a shape characteristic of dropper/stealer payloads. The Bun-only entrypoint means the payload is never parsed or executed by Node, evading Node-based install-time scanners. The package advertises itself as a slate-react fork (a pure React library), which has no legitimate need to pull an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or execute an opaque 727 KB obfuscated blob. Package metadata compounds the concern: the scope `@ornikar/*` implies an Ornikar-maintained fork, but `repository` points at git://github.com/CorentinAndre/slate.git (an unrelated personal account), while dist/ mirrors upstream slate-react and setup.mjs / math_init.js are unrelated to the advertised library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
